domain_context: hybrid_fullstack DJ Skill Tracker App (Fitness-style gamification for DJs)
emotional_tone: High energy, tactical, competitive, immersive club vibe

layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6
layout_and_spacing.bento_strategy: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID. Every pixel utilized, h-full on children for uniform stretching.

dashboard_cards.css_classes: bg-[#121212] border border-white/10 rounded-xl overflow-hidden relative

premium_locked_state.css_classes: backdrop-blur-md bg-black/80 flex items-center justify-center absolute inset-0 z-10

buttons.primary: bg-[#00E5FF] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-widest hover:bg-white transition-colors duration-300 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0.4)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#FF007F] text-[#FF007F] hover:bg-[#FF007F] hover:text-white transition-all duration-300

progress_bars.fill: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00E5FF] to-[#FF007F] shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(0,229,255,0.6)] rounded-full h-full

rank_badges.style: Metallic gradients with subtle inner shadows and glowing drop shadows, hexagonal or sharp shield geometry.

charts.style: Dark background, transparent grid lines, vibrant neon lines for data (Acid Green / Electric Blue)

interactions.hover_states: Always explicitly define text color on hover. Lift cards slightly (-translate-y-1).
interactions.animations: Use Framer Motion / react-native-reanimated. Spring animations for level-ups and progress bar fills. Smooth fade-ins for dashboard widgets.

hero_background.description: DJ focused on mixing music illuminated by vibrant neon lights. Used for auth screen or main welcome banner.

session_analysis_bg.description: Close up of dj's turntable. Used as a subtle background for the audio set analysis view.

challenge_cards.description: DJ mixer setup colorful lights. Used as thumbnail for specific challenges.

icons.usage: Use thick weights, apply glow filters for active states.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='log-session-btn', data-testid='premium-toggle-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI focusing on a dark, club-like aesthetic heavily utilizing Tailwind CSS for the styling.
Install the following fonts: Unbounded (wght 400..900) for headings and Manrope for body text.
Implement tabbed/bottom navigation system (Dashboard, Sessions, Challenges, Stats, Profile) suitable for cross-platform.
For the Premium toggle, build a mocked switch that blurs out 'Advanced Stats' cards and displays an 'Upgrade to Premium' lock icon.
Rank mapping (Cuivre V to I, up to Maître) should visually use the metallic gradients defined in the 'ranks' color object.
Implement session logging with distinct type selectors (Mix, Transitions, Freestyle).
Dashboard should prioritize displaying current rank, progress bar to the next division, and total practice time.
Follow the BENTO GRID strategy for the layout: tight gaps, utilized space, dark tactical aesthetic with neon pops.
